page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; one marginal note at the right, beside the line "Respondet secundò Pearsonius usum". Running head at the top, page number at the top right, gathering signature at the foot right.

main_text.p: ceptâ primæ Cathedræ dignitate, cæteri omnes compresbyteri in functionibus Ecclesiasticis esse quodammodo pares; sibi constituere Episcopos idem est, nisi me fallit animus, quod eos sibi eligere & præficere. Respondet secundò Pearsonius usumpag.167. hunc Alexandrinum qualis qualis sit non esse disciplinæ Ignatianæ adeò contrarium, & ex diametro oppositum, ut inde ignoratio Ignatij Epistolici colligi possit, responsionis suæ hanc adfert rationem, usum illum videlicet obtinuisse in vacatione sedis, & ad electionem aut promotionem Episcopi tantùm spectare, Ignatium verò de electione aut promotione Episcopi nihil scripsisse. Sed hæc secunda Viri docti solutio priore non est so-[?]lidior: si enim Presbyteris Alexandrinis licitum fuit sibi Episcopos constituere, quidni etiam alias absque Episcopo functiones obire? Et si quod est maximū jure facere potuerunt, in minoribus functionibus idem jus eis competivisse par est credere, ideóque Holstenius ex Hieronymi verbis ritè colligebat Presbyteros Episcopis exceptâ primæ Cathedræ dignitate, in functionibus Ecclesiasticis esse quodammodo pares: pares autem esse non poterant nisi illis aliquid facere sine Episcopo conce[illegible, ~3 letters]m fuisset, cùm Episcopo quædam

page.notes: The page number is printed as "121" with a worn final digit; read as 121. A blot covers the end of "concessum" on the last line. The word "solidior" is split at the line end as "so-" and "lidior"; the first part is read with doubt. The mark after "obire" is a printed or smudged character, read as "?". The gathering signature at the foot is read as "Q".
